_source: Lean core for every code route (docs/design/lean-core.md): Codex's design with a short codex-tuned prompt, workspace preload, re-check on edit and no extra verification layers. Measured on the 52 eval tasks, paired against Codex 0.171 on the same model (docs/results/final20, final21): 196/208 vs 186/208 solved, cost per solved 0.81x, median per-task time 0.82x. The previous default is kept as the "codex" profile (MH_PROFILE=codex).
